caveats: Asking prices are not transaction prices; associations are not causal effects.
Latest listing attributes are joined to historical prices; attribute history was not collected and is not reconstructed.
Disappearance means absence from a bounded collection scope, not a proven sale.
Selected pages and changing scopes can bias composition and observed volume.
Fair-value survival buckets require an independent supplied fair_price_pkr; database observations have no such reference and remain unknown.
Posting dates are unavailable in normalized storage; volume uses first observation.
Run count includes published runs represented by observations only.
Listing hashes are database-local pseudonyms; hashing is not proof of anonymization.
Public samples contain at most 100 recent drop events; residuals at most 200 cars.
Fair-price estimates are conditional medians with approximate residual ranges.
